verdict.rationale: Rive is an animation/interactive-graphics tool with components, data binding, and view models, but there is no evidence of a design-tokens/variables system (colors, spacing, typography) with modes/themes applied across designs — the closest concepts (components, data binding) address reusability and runtime data, not token/theme management. Missing for 10: token or variable definitions, theme/mode switching, cross-design application of shared style values.
